rows.text: returns 0 when `rdx` or `rcx` is null; otherwise, for each object in the chain starting at `rcx` and following qword `+0x78`, it walks the list whose sentinel is at the object's `+0xa0` (first element qword `[obj+0xa0]`, next element qword `[elem]`, the sentinel itself ending the walk) and returns the first element whose non-null qword `+0x18` points to a zero-terminated string byte-equal to the one at `rdx`; when the chain ends it returns 0

stores `00D315B0` to qword `[rcx]`, calls `00584730` on qword `[rcx+0x20]` when that is non-null and dword `[rcx+0x18]` is not negative, zeroes `[rcx+0x20]` and dword `[rcx+0x18]`, stores `00D312F0` to `[rcx]`, and when bit `0x1` of `edx` is set calls `00584730(rcx)` if bit `0x4` is clear or `0016D6A0(rcx, 0x28)` if it is set; it returns `rcx`

returns 0 when qword `[rcx+0x10]` is null or the low 31 bits of its dword `+0` are zero; otherwise, for each of that many element pointers (read through the qword at `+8` when the count is above 1, and taken from `+8` itself when it is 1), it takes `c` = the low 31 bits of the element's dword `+8` and `b` = 1 when the low 31 bits of its dword `+0x18` are non-zero (else 0), computes ((2`c`+`b`+2) rounded down to even)*16 + 0x1f rounded down to a multiple of 16, plus (6`c`+0x11) rounded down to a multiple of 16, and returns the unsigned maximum of these values

reads `s` = qword `[rcx+0x18]` and fills the record at `r8`: dword `+0` = 0x30, qword `+4` = 2, dword `+0xc` = 0, float `+0x30` = the result of the vtable slot `+0x20` of the object qword `[rcx+0x20]` (0.0 when that is null), word `+0x34` = the low 31 bits of dword `[s+8]`, word `+0x36` = the low 31 bits `k` of dword `[s+0x18]`, qword `+0x18` = qword `[s]`, dword `+0x10` = the word at that pointer, qword `+0x28` = qword `[s+0x20]` and dword `+0x20` = `k`*0x58 + 0xf rounded down to a multiple of 16; it returns 0x40

writes to the record at `r8` qword 0x10, qword 0 and the pointers `01F2CE40`, `01F2CE70` and `01F2CE58`, then, with `n` = the low 31 bits of dword `+0x20` of `t` = qword `[rcx+0x10]`, walks `n` 0x18-byte entries at qword `[t+0x28]` and appends to the qwords from `r8+0x28` a value from the 0x30-byte record selected by the entry's dword `+0xc` in the array at qword `[rdx+0x20]`: for record type dword 0 it is `02CAEB60` when the record's dword `+0x10` is below 0x80 and 0 otherwise, for type 1 it is the record's qword `+8` when the entry's qword `+0` is one of the three pointers and 0 otherwise, and 0 for any other type; it terminates the list with a zero qword and returns (`n`*8 + 0x2f rounded down to a multiple of 16) + 0x10

returns 0 when `edx` equals the low 31 bits `c` of dword `[rcx+0x18]`; otherwise, unless `edx` equals the whole dword, it calls `005E3040(edx, qword [rcx+0x20], min(edx, c))` and returns 0xd when that yields null for a non-zero `edx`, else calls `00584730` on the old qword `[rcx+0x20]` when that differs from the new pointer, is non-null and dword `[rcx+0x18]` is not negative, and stores the new pointer and `edx` to `[rcx+0x20]` and `[rcx+0x18]`; when `c` is below `edx` it zeroes the qwords from index `c` to `edx`-1 of the array at `[rcx+0x20]`; it returns 0

calls the vtable slot `+8` of `rdx` with `rdx` and `rcx` and returns 0 when its byte result is zero; otherwise, for each of the low 31 bits of dword `[rcx+0x18]` qwords in the array at `[rcx+0x20]`, calls the vtable slot `+0x18` of each non-null element with that element, `rdx` and `rcx` and returns 0 when one yields a zero byte; after the loop it calls the vtable slot `+0x18` of `rdx` with `rdx`, `rcx` and `r8`, and returns 1
